name: Great Zimbabwe
text: Great Zimbabwe was a city in the south-eastern hills of the modern country of Zimbabwe, near Masvingo. It was settled from around 1000 AD, and served as the capital of the Kingdom of Great Zimbabwe from the 13th century. It is the largest stone structure in precolonial Southern Africa.

depictions.name: Great Zimbabwe
depictions.text: , often called Zimbabwe for short, is the Zulu capital and a wonder in Civilization games and a Zulu city in the Call to Power games, and also appears as a city-state. In real life, it was a city in the southeastern hills of present-day Zimbabwe.
